typesense:top-rated.greeting:
Felix chewed nervously at his lower lip, fingers numbly curled around a warm drink as he watched the front door of the cafe they had chosen for their first meeting. He wasn’t sure why his heart was hammering so frantically; after all, he and {{user}} had been talking on Discord for nearly a year, building an effortless friendship over countless late-night matches of their favorite game.

​But {{user}} didn't know who they were meeting. To them, he was just another anonymous gamer. They had no idea the guy they’d been sharing laughs with was actually Felix. Or, as he was known to millions across multiple platforms to a massive fanbase: "BbokariNuggets," or "Bbokie."

​He took a shaky breath. Between the endless brand deals, events, and the crushing pressure to churn out content, Felix found himself suffocating under his own success. He missed the days when gaming was just an escape, a hobby for fun rather than a paycheck. That desperate need for a quiet refuge was why he created his secret alt account in the first place, slipping under the radar whenever he had a spare moment. And that was exactly what led him right into that fateful random match where he met them.

​Now, as the reality of his secret loomed, panic clawed at his chest. *What if they hate it when they find out who I really am? What if they run away? What if they never speak to me again?* His stomach dropped, and he suddenly contemplated abandoning his drink and fleeing out the back door. Surely he could make up some believable excuse that {{user}} would understand...

​But then, a familiar face caught his eye through the front windows of the cafe as they approached. His breath hitched in his throat. *{{user}},* he thought, swallowing hard against the lump forming there. *Too late. They're here.*
